audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's advice is 'Build MR for his R'. Feast deals flat true damage.
audit.why: Riot's Feast text is 'a high amount of true damage' — resistances do not reduce it at all, so MR is the wrong answer to the ability the page tells you to build MR against. The countable facts are Feast 80s at rank 1 / 175 range, Feral Scream 11s silence (it shuts off both your Parrrley-detonate and your Remove Scurvy mid-combo), and Rupture 6s at 950 range.
audit.corrected: Stated the true-damage rule in tldr, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns, and named Feral Scream and Rupture with their cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers carry [Cho'Gath, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank, Cho'Gath, Gangplank, Gangplank]; the packet chart, the mirror audit and the prose all say [Skill, Gangplank, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Gangplank].
audit.why: whys[0] calls level 1 a pure last-hit standoff (Skill). whys[1] says the early window is yours (Gangplank). whys[2], whys[3], whys[4] and whys[5] all describe Cho'Gath windows — the last of them ending 'so he holds the lane' — while both layers credit three of those rows to you. The mirror already set this exact chart on the Cho'Gath side, so leaving it would put the two pages in direct contradiction.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 set to Skill / Gangplank / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath, matching the mirror. One atomic group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes and phases[4].why treat level 6 as a generic reassessment and give you the first-item row.
audit.why: Feast at 6 (80/70/60s) is the pivot, and each Feast kill is permanent max health, so his first-item and 2-item HP pool out-grows a single-item keg chain. Your windows are level 2-3 Parrrley poke before his HP is padded, and the late map game where Cannon Barrage (160s, 30000 range) sieges around an immobile target.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Feast, its 80s cooldown and why armour and your heal do not answer it; the first-item row moves to Cho'Gath.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed no numbers and told you to track 'your committal tool'.
audit.why: Feast 80s, Feral Scream 11s, Rupture 6s, Remove Scurvy 22s are the windows this lane is actually played on.

notes: dosFull[1].t is 'Build MR for his R', which is wrong — Feast is true damage — but the string is 18 characters and the applier skips anything under 25, so it needs a manual fix. Both layers repeatedly say Remove Scurvy cleanses the Rupture knockup; Riot's Rupture text is 'popping enemy units into the air' (airborne) and nothing in the kit files says whether Remove Scurvy clears airborne, so I left every instance alone and logged it as unverified. The Cho'Gath kit flags Rupture as 'grounding', which contradicts Riot's own knockup description — treated as a parse misfire, same call the mirror made. Both packet suspectNames are false positives.
